sources.title: DOH Barangay Health Workers Facilitator Guide, 2022
sources.retrieval: Original project Drive PDF downloaded successfully; 126 pages. PDF pp.19 and 21 rendered and visually inspected; original printed page labels confirmed.
sources.claim_coverage: UHC maps to Contribute to workplace innovation (three-hour module), with outcomes to identify opportunities, discuss/develop ideas with others, and integrate change.

exact_evidence.passage: Identify opportunities to do things better; Discuss and develop ideas with others; Integrate ideas for change in the workplace.

sources.limits: PDF p.22 / printed p.15 maps entrepreneurial skills to the separate workplace-policies topic. No improvement-specific activity or evaluation rubric is printed on p.21. Full-text search found no rubric; evaluation appears in introductory p.8. The lesson practice/rubric is a clearly labeled instructional adaptation; existing module notes supply the 45-minute exercise. The web PDF mirror exceeded tool size limits; the Drive original was used.

sources.title: DOH Barangay Health Workers Reference Manual, 2022 — BHW roles
sources.retrieval: Original project Drive PDF downloaded successfully; 150 pages. Text extracted and page renders checked.
sources.claim_coverage: BHWs support information, community participation and primary care teams; maintain communication with local health staff; contribute to local planning.

exact_evidence.passage: Pinapanatili ng mga BHW ang magandang relasyon at komunikasyon sa mga lider at miyembro ng komunidad, pati na din sa mga health staff ng lungsod/munisipyo.

sources.limits: This supports collaborative information work, not independent authority to approve a service, policy, clinic or benefit. Locally agreed next-week visits are fictional examples.

sources.title: DOH BHW Reference Manual — UHC direction
sources.retrieval: Original PDF text and rendered printed page verified.
sources.claim_coverage: UHC direction includes stronger BHW skills and community health promotion and coordination.
sources.limits: No universal local contact, service availability, benefit entitlement, free-care or measured-impact claim is derived. The original PhilHealth-reminder example is replaced with a contact/message example to avoid repeating 1.2.1 and adding entitlement detail.

sources.title: Republic Act No.11223 — UHC principles and objectives
sources.retrieval: Current statute text opened with web tool.
sources.claim_coverage: People-oriented delivery, coordinated implementation and clear roles are background context.
sources.limits: No new statutory authority is assigned to a BHW; benefits or provider selection are not taught in this improvement story. YAKAP is not needed or inserted. Its shared pronunciation rule is preserved unchanged.

instructional_adaptations: Vlanche/Ernesto scenario; two-visit observation; current contact and short message; agreement; next-week trial; Friday review; non-identifying count and questions.
Six-screen planning cycle and 45-minute facilitation split within the existing module plan.
Topic-specific application alternatives and observable kaya na / kailangan pa ng practice / hindi pa rubric.
supplemental_visual_check: Original Manual PDF pp.11–12 / printed pp.3–4 and Guide PDF p.22 / printed p.15 inspected; confirms role/context and the separate entrepreneurial-skills topic.
